suites.label: CASTLE C250
suites.selection: Up to 2 vulnerable and 1 safe C program per selected CWE.

cases.name: CASTLE-22-1.c
cases.description: Improper limitation of a pathname leads to path traversal vulnerability.

cases.name: CASTLE-22-2.c
cases.description: Unimplemented validation of a pathname leads to path traversal vulnerability.

cases.name: CASTLE-22-7.c
cases.description: Proper path validation prevents path traversal.

cases.name: CASTLE-78-1.c
cases.description: Missing input validation of fgets input allows for OS command injection

cases.name: CASTLE-78-2.c
cases.description: Missing input validation of command line arguments allows for OS command injection

cases.name: CASTLE-78-7.c
cases.description: OS command input is verified sufficiently.

cases.name: CASTLE-89-1.c
cases.description: Missing input validation of fgets input allows for SQL injection.

cases.name: CASTLE-89-2.c
cases.description: Insufficient inpit validation of fgets input allows for SQL injection.

cases.name: CASTLE-89-7.c
cases.description: Static SQL query is not vulnerable to injection.

cases.name: CASTLE-125-1.c
cases.description: Upper array boundary error violation.

cases.name: CASTLE-125-2.c
cases.description: Upper array boundary error violation.

cases.name: CASTLE-125-7.c
cases.description: No read out of bounds in any iterations.

cases.name: CASTLE-134-1.c
cases.description: The format string is sourced fron an input without sanitization

cases.name: CASTLE-134-2.c
cases.description: The format string is sourced fron an input without sanitization

cases.name: CASTLE-134-7.c
cases.description: The format string not sourced from outside the program

cases.name: CASTLE-190-1.c
cases.description: Arithmetic overflow in multiplication.

cases.name: CASTLE-190-2.c
cases.description: Integer overflow in atoi function.

cases.name: CASTLE-190-7.c
cases.description: There are no arithmetic overflows in any of these functions.

cases.name: CASTLE-327-1.c
cases.description: Password is hashed with MD5.

cases.name: CASTLE-327-2.c
cases.description: Password is hashed with MD5 missdirected by function names.

cases.name: CASTLE-327-7.c
cases.description: Password is hashed with SHA256.

cases.name: CASTLE-416-1.c
cases.description: Memory is used after being freed

cases.name: CASTLE-416-2.c
cases.description: Memory is used after being freed

cases.name: CASTLE-416-7.c
cases.description: Both allocated memory chunks are freed, and not used after free

cases.name: CASTLE-787-1.c
cases.description: Buffer overflow in scanf function.

cases.name: CASTLE-787-2.c
cases.description: Buffer overflow in strcpy function.

cases.name: CASTLE-787-7.c
cases.description: Not vulnerable, since memory allocation is properly null-checked.
